description: Design presets: the relations Configure uses to generate dimensions (program choices, status 'program', until the lab edits them) and the microscope field of view. Edit in UStack › Presets.

hall_bar.width_per_arm.label: Channel width W / arm width
hall_bar.width_per_arm.description: W = this × arm width (arm width = electrode width target). Narrow probes next to a wide channel barely short the Hall voltage.

hall_bar.pitch_per_width.label: Probe pitch / channel width
hall_bar.pitch_per_width.description: Probe pitch = max(this × W, arm width + spacing, arm width + arm-spacing minimum); L = (pairs − 1) × pitch.

hall_bar.n_probe_pairs.label: Voltage-probe pairs
hall_bar.n_probe_pairs.description: 2 is the minimum for a four-probe Rxx and an Rxy.

hall_bar.arm_length_per_width_no_gate.label: Arm length / W (no gate to clear)
hall_bar.arm_length_per_width_no_gate.description: Without a gate to clear: arm length = max(this × W, contact overlap + spacing).

hall_bar.sd_extension_per_width_no_gate.label: S/D extension / W (no gate to clear)
hall_bar.sd_extension_per_width_no_gate.description: Without a gate to clear: source/drain extension beyond the outer probes = this × W.

gates.margin_spacings.label: Gate margin
gates.margin_spacings.description: Gate margin g = max(stacking shift, this × electrode spacing): how far a graphite gate is designed beyond the channel.

gates.bg_extra_spacings.label: Extra BG size under a TG
gates.bg_extra_spacings.description: A bottom gate under a top gate is this × spacing larger on every side.

hbn.margin_spacings.label: hBN margin
hbn.margin_spacings.description: Every hBN = the largest conducting flake + this × spacing on every side.

hbn.top_margin_spacings.label: Top hBN margin
hbn.top_margin_spacings.description: The top (cap) hBN = the largest conducting flake + this × spacing on every side.

prepattern.tmd_overlap_spacings.label: Device over each electrode tip
prepattern.tmd_overlap_spacings.description: Two-column pre-patterned electrodes (Mak): the device layer reaches this × spacing onto each electrode beyond the gap.

tg.length_extra_spacings.label: Metal TG beyond the outer probes
tg.length_extra_spacings.description: Metal top-gate length = L + arm width + 2 × this × spacing.

tg.overhang_spacings.label: Metal TG overhang
tg.overhang_spacings.description: How far the metal top gate's lead reaches past the graphene edge.

cg.reach_spacings.label: Contact-gate reaches
cg.reach_spacings.description: Contact gate: inner reach, outer reach and side extension, each this × spacing.

sg.gap_spacings.label: Split-gate gap
sg.gap_spacings.description: Split gate: gap to the top-gate edge.

fingers.width_um.label: Finger width
fingers.width_um.description: Width of every pre-patterned finger (straight part).

fingers.pitch_um.label: Finger pitch (centre to centre)
fingers.pitch_um.description: Fingers are 2.2 µm apart, centre to centre (the lab's drawings: 2.2–2.3 µm pitch, 1.4–1.5 µm edge spacing).

fingers.column_gap_um.label: Gap between the two columns
fingers.column_gap_um.description: Tip-to-tip distance between the two facing finger columns.

fingers.min_overlap_um.label: Finger tip on the twisted region
fingers.min_overlap_um.description: A finger pair counts when the channel between its tips and this much of each finger from its tip lie on the twisted region (program choice: one finger width).

fingers.bbn_margin_um.label: Finger ends inside the bottom hBN by
fingers.bbn_margin_um.source: Edited in UStack by user on 2026-11-17
fingers.bbn_margin_um.description: Each column's fingers run from the tip until they are this far inside the bottom hBN boundary (as long as possible: less need on the covering hBN). Without a located bottom hBN the fixed finger length is used.

fingers.straight_um.label: Straight part from the tip
fingers.straight_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
fingers.straight_um.description: Fingers run straight this far from the tip, then fan out (lab drawings: 5.5–12 µm, median 9.5).

fingers.length_um.label: Finger length (tip to far end)
fingers.length_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
fingers.length_um.description: Extent of a finger along its axis (lab drawings: 14.4–30.6 µm, median 21.8). Used only when the bottom hBN is not located: otherwise each column is as long as the bottom hBN allows.

fingers.far_pitch_um.label: Pitch at the far ends
fingers.far_pitch_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
fingers.far_pitch_um.description: Centre-to-centre pitch at the fanned-out ends (lab drawings: 2.9–4.6 µm, median 3.8).

fingers.far_width_um.label: Width beyond the bend
fingers.far_width_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
fingers.far_width_um.description: Finger width on the fanned part (lab drawings: 0.78–1.24 µm, median 1.1).

cg.tooth_length_um.label: Contact-gate tooth length
cg.tooth_length_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
cg.tooth_length_um.description: Each contact-gate tooth covers its finger from the tip outward this far (lab drawings: 5.3–11.1 µm, median 6.1).

cg.bus_tmd_gap_um.label: Contact-gate bus from the TMD by
cg.bus_tmd_gap_um.source: Edited in UStack by user on 2026-11-18
cg.bus_tmd_gap_um.description: The bus joining the contact-gate teeth (and its lead) stays this far from the TMD (device layers, e.g. both WSe2 halves); each column's teeth are as short as that allows, so the two columns may differ.

cg.hbn_margin_um.label: Contact gate inside its hBN by
cg.hbn_margin_um.source: Edited in UStack by user on 2026-11-18
cg.hbn_margin_um.description: The whole contact gate (teeth, bus and its lead) stays this far inside the hBN it is written on (the middle hBN): off it, it would touch the fingers. The bus lead is shortened to stay inside.

cg.bus_width_um.label: Contact-gate bus width
cg.bus_width_um.description: Width of the bar joining the teeth behind them (program choice: the electrode width).

cg.bus_extension_um.label: Bus beyond the last tooth
cg.bus_extension_um.description: The bus bar runs this far beyond the outer tooth, where an electrode lands on it (program choice).

electrodes.width_um.label: Electrode width
electrodes.width_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
electrodes.width_um.description: Width of the EBL electrodes from the fingers to the bond pads (lab drawings: 1.57–1.7 µm, median 1.64).

electrodes.land_from_tip_um.label: Electrode lands at (from the tip)
electrodes.land_from_tip_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
electrodes.land_from_tip_um.description: Where an electrode starts on its finger, measured from the finger tip (lab drawings: 13.1–15.3 µm, median 14.2).

electrodes.bg_contact_um.label: Back-gate contact bar
electrodes.bg_contact_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs (Stack 1/3/4), docs/wse2_design_report.md
electrodes.bg_contact_um.description: Size of the bar that contacts the back gate at each end of the gap strip (lab drawings: ≈3.5 µm).

electrodes.gate_contact_clearance_um.label: Gate contact clearance
electrodes.gate_contact_clearance_um.description: A gate contact stays this far from the twisted region and the fingers (program choice).

electrodes.cg_overlap_um.label: Electrode overlap on the contact-gate bus
electrodes.cg_overlap_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs: layer-7 electrode on the layer-6 contact gate, Stack 1 2.95 / 4.52 / 7.48 µm, Stack 3 1.57 µm (median 3.7)
electrodes.cg_overlap_um.description: Each contact-gate electrode runs this far back along its bus lead from the lead's end (inside the lead), for a good contact (user, 2026-11-20: overlap the bus more).

electrodes.finger_overlap_um.label: Electrode overlap on a finger (at most)
electrodes.finger_overlap_um.source: measured in the lab's tWSe2-1 GDS designs: layer-7 electrode along a layer-5 finger, median 12.17 µm (Stack 1) / 9.69 µm (Stack 3), docs/wse2_design_report.md (median 10.9)
electrodes.finger_overlap_um.description: A Hall-bar electrode runs at most this far along its finger, back from the finger's far end (user, 2026-11-20: overlap a bit, not so far that the gold lands on the top hBN). It starts later where the flakes above the fingers need it (electrodes.flake_clearance_um).

electrodes.flake_clearance_um.label: Electrode clearance from the flakes above the fingers
electrodes.flake_clearance_um.source: Edited in UStack by user on 2026-11-20
electrodes.flake_clearance_um.description: Where a Hall-bar electrode lands on its finger, its metal stays this far outside every flake above the fingers on the chip when the electrodes are written (top hBN, middle hBN, the device layers, a graphite top gate — for a conducting flake at least ebl.contact_to_graphite_gate_min_um).

electrodes.pad_landing_um.label: Landing square on the bond-pad lead
electrodes.pad_landing_um.source: Edited in UStack by user on 2026-11-20
electrodes.pad_landing_um.description: Side of the square each electrode ends in, centred on the end of its bond-pad lead (half of it over the lead), for a good contact. Larger than the lead's width overlaps it on three sides; it must leave the spacing to the neighbouring leads' squares.

microscope.fov_100x_width_um.label: 100x image width
microscope.fov_100x_width_um.description: Field of view of a 100x image (the whole image, any resolution). Other objectives scale as 100 / magnification.

microscope.fov_100x_height_um.label: 100x image height
microscope.fov_100x_height_um.description: Field of view of a 100x image (height).
